svg.title: 3 ∑︁ j ρj = (I + zσz)/2. The stationary preparation is τ ⊗τ. Since Tr(Ejτ) = 1/3, the first two emitted symbols are independent uniform trits; thereafter the displayed update proves every finite word of the delayed law by induction. This stationary preparation differs from that of the qutrit source and is explicitly budgeted. Each symbol has one nonzero Kraus operator, so the complete registered one-step channel has Choi rank exactly three. No registered three-symbol channel with three nonzero outputs can have smaller rank, since its orthogonal output blocks each contribute at least one. At 0 < λ < 1 all words are positive and every word Kraus operator is rank one after two steps. The full registered n-step channel therefore has Choi rank 3n for n ≥2, attaining the alphabet-imposed floor with retained final memory. It streams with one fresh three-level record port and one fresh three-level record-copy bath per step; old baths never return. These resources are not an uncounted fresh source or a correlated tape. The initial mixed preparation and its rank-four purifier are separate stock. For λ = 0 the exact-law support floor changes to 9 2n−2. At λ = 1 the process is iid and memory one suffices; this redundant four-dimensional implementation is not a memory optimum. All claimed two-point frontiers exclude that iid endpoint. A coherent archive or an initially mixed bath defines a different optimization task. Let τ = 1
